en.headline: Nearly 270,000 mainland visitors entered by 9pm on day one
en.dek: Immigration officers recorded more than 897,000 cross-boundary movements by 9pm on Thursday, with most mainland arrivals using Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.
body: Hong Kong recorded more than 897,000 cross-boundary movements by 9pm on the first day of the mainland National Day Golden Week, the Immigration Department said.

Arrivals exceeded 521,000, of which nearly 270,000 were mainland visitors. The department said the largest number of mainland visitors entered through the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point. Departures exceeded 376,000, including more than 238,000 Hong Kong residents, with Lo Wu the busiest exit for residents.

The evening tally sits above the afternoon figure already reported for the same day, when about 225,000 mainland visitors had entered by 4pm. HK01, citing the department's figures, said the mainland visitor count by 9pm was higher than the 232,751 recorded on National Day last year.

The Golden Week holiday runs from 1 to 7 October. Officials had earlier said they expected about 1.29 million mainland visitors over the week. The department has also projected busy land crossings, with the outbound peak expected on Saturday and the inbound peak on Sunday.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日晚上九時近27萬內地旅客入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，截至星期四晚上九時，各管制站錄得逾89.7萬人次出入境，內地旅客入境近27萬，以落馬洲支線最多。
body: 入境處表示，內地國慶黃金周首日截至晚上九時，本港各管制站錄得超過89.7萬人次出入境。
入境超過52.1萬人次，其中內地旅客近27萬人次，最多經落馬洲支線管制站入境。出境超過37.6萬人次，本港居民佔超過23.8萬人次，最多經羅湖出境。
晚上的數字高於同日下午四時已公布的約22.5萬內地旅客入境。香港01引述入境處數字稱，晚上九時的內地旅客人次多於去年國慶日的232,751人次。
黃金周由十月一日至七日。當局早前預計整段假期約有129萬內地旅客來港，並估計陸路出境高峰在星期六、入境高峰在星期日。
